# rwx_service_account (Data Source)

Looks up one active RWX service account by exactly one of ID, immutable name, or display name. Prefer immutable name over display name. Missing or ambiguous matches fail during planning when inputs are known. Does not expose credentials or permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rwx_service_account" "deploy" {
  name = "deploy-automation"
}

data "rwx_service_account" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

data "rwx_service_account" "by_display_name" {
  display_name = "Deploy automation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The display name. Legacy duplicates cause an ambiguity error. Specify exactly one of id, name, or display_name.
- `id` (String) The stable service-account ID. Specify exactly one of id, name, or display_name.
- `name` (String) The immutable reference name (preferred selector). Specify exactly one of id, name, or display_name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The service-account description.
- `identity_id` (String) The stable identity ID.
